agenda_items.title: System Migration Project Status Review
agenda_items.summary: Review of the IT system migration project covering database migration, application layer migration, user acceptance testing, data mapping challenges, and payroll integration parallel-run testing plans.

agenda_items.title: Budget Approval
agenda_items.summary: Review and approval of the RM 240,000 migration budget, including licensing, infrastructure, and professional services costs, with a phased payment structure agreed by all departments.

decisions.statement: Rajan's team will conduct parallel-run testing for payroll integration for at least two pay cycles before full cut-over, with two engineers dedicated to this testing.

Diputuskan bahawa projek migrasi sistem akan diteruskan dengan struktur pembayaran berperingkat (40% upfront, 30% at go-live, 30% at three months post-go-live) seperti yang dibentangkan oleh Siti Nabilah, dengan jumlah kos keseluruhan RM 240,000.

action_items.description: Prepare a detailed technical timeline (Gantt chart) with all migration milestones and share it on Teams.
action_items.raw_text: Will do la. I'll prepare a Gantt chart with all the milestones and share it on Teams.

action_items.description: Hantar ringkasan persetujuan belanjawan kepada Pengarah Kewangan untuk kelulusan rasmi.
action_items.raw_text: Siti, Sila hantar ringkasan persetujuan belanjawan kepada Pengarah Kewangan sebelum 22 Januari 2025 untuk kelulusan rasmi.

action_items.description: Draft the budget approval memo and get it signed off.
action_items.raw_text: Ok no problem. I'll draft the budget approval memo and get it signed off.

action_items.description: Consolidate HR module requirements from all HR users and prepare the requirements document.
action_items.raw_text: Boleh lah. I'll consolidate the requirements from all HR users and send by Friday.

action_items.description: Start the configuration sprint using the HR module requirements once received.
action_items.raw_text: Perfect. Once we have that, we can start the configuration sprint next Monday.
